messages:
Leah Park: Heads-up from SI: B200 nodes intermittently throttle under sustained 2k token streams. partners asking if we should gate listing or proceed with preview.
Arjun Rao: Data point: observed thermal throttle at ~75 minutes into a sustained run. perf drop ~22% p95->p99. logs attached to thread.
Ben Thompson: That will impact latency SLOs for streaming apps. Can we add an auto-fallback route to H100/H200 during throttle windows?
intel_bob: Intel note: we pushed a firmware tweak v4.1.7 to partners 2026-06-11. early partner lab runs show reduced frequency but not elimination. full fix TBD.
qa-bot: Smoke tests summary:
- 4/6 runs: passed stable for 1 hour
- 2/6 runs: throttle event at 45-80 mins
- repro steps and docker tag in Confluence
Ben Thompson: Ok fallback policy then. Also need marketplace copy to surface "preview - limited sustained throughput" and guidance for streaming customers.
marketing-ella: Draft snippet: "B200 Preview: optimized for batch & throughput; streaming customers should consider H100/H200 or enable fallback routing. Limited availability in APAC until firmware stabilization." Thoughts?
Leah Park: Decisions proposed: 1) Partner preview (invite-only) 2026-06-18, 2) Marketplace soft-list NA/EU 2026-06-25 with "Preview - limited sustained throughput" flag, 3) Gate APAC until further firmware validation (target early July), 4) Enable automatic routing fallback to H200->H100 during detected throttles.
Arjun Rao: Action owners: Arjun -> telemetry rule for throttle detection, Ben -> fallback routing config, Intel -> firmware validation timeline, Marketing -> listing copy + support Q&A, Leah -> press cadence & legal checklist.
intel_bob: We'll prioritize extended stress runs and share partner lab report by 2026-06-22.
release-bot: Pipeline note: `marketplace-preview` scheduled for 2026-06-25 17:00 UTC pending legal.
Leah Park: Thanks all. If firmware slips we'll delay APAC and hold joint press. tagging: @intel_bob pls post lab report in-thread. :thumbsup:
